activities.name: Relaxing Day at Calangute Beach
activities.description: Spend a leisurely day sunbathing, swimming, and enjoying beachside shacks. Includes sunbed rental and a short sunset walk.

activities.name: Goan Culinary Food Tour
activities.description: Guided tasting tour of local Goan specialties such as fish curry, vindaloo, bebinca, and feni at popular eateries in Panaji.

activities.name: Dolphin Watching Cruise from Sinquerim
activities.description: Morning boat trip to spot playful dolphins, with a brief commentary on marine life and a light snack on board.

activities.name: Old Goa Heritage Walk
activities.description: Guided walking tour of UNESCO‑listed churches and cathedrals (Basilica of Bom Jesus, Se Cathedral) plus a stop at a local market.

activities.name: Spice Plantation & Sunset Dinner
activities.description: Visit a spice plantation for a short guided walk, learn about local spices, and enjoy a sunset dinner featuring traditional Goan cuisine.
